name: Furniture
description: Craftable furniture: a rideable bbmodel chair (sitting is mod policy over the engine actor-pose API), iron chains as a WASM-baked custom shape in three axis variants (vertical, north/south, east/west) oriented by the clicked face, a torch-bright gold chandelier that hangs centred on the cell it is placed against, a hollow slate cauldron (a second WASM-baked shape) that mixes flower dye and dips dyeable items, and a painting table that paints a flag's cloth pixel by pixel.
summary: A rideable chair, iron chains, a chandelier, a dyeing cauldron and a painting table for flags.
